text: Advertising expenditure is recovered almost entirely through consumer prices rather than through volume gains. In the 340 categories examined, a one-point rise in advertising-to-revenue ratio was associated with a 0.8 point rise in shelf price, with no measurable improvement in product quality. Categories with the heaviest promotional spend also showed the weakest correlation between price and independently assessed durability.

source_title: When network effects fail to defend
text: Network effects defended margins in only a minority of the marketplaces studied. Liquidity advantages eroded quickly wherever switching costs stayed low and supply was multi-homing, and in 61 of 94 cases a challenger reached parity within three years. Founders consistently overestimated defensibility by conflating growth in users with growth in the cost of leaving.

source_title: Exit options and consent in labour markets
text: Consent to employment terms is only meaningful where a worker holds a credible exit option. Where the median household holds under one month of expenditure in savings, acceptance of unfavourable terms rises sharply and cannot be read as free bargaining. The report describes this as structural rather than contractual coercion.

Gig platform drivers reported nominal freedom to decline work alongside algorithmic penalties that made declining costly. Acceptance rates below 80% triggered reduced dispatch priority for 71% of surveyed drivers, producing effective schedule control without an employment relationship.

Capability gaps between leading frontier models narrowed to within measurement noise on most public benchmarks during the review period. Differentiation shifted decisively toward context handling, tool orchestration and retrieval quality rather than raw parameter scale.

Systems that stored raw conversation logs and retrieved by embedding similarity degraded steadily as the corpus grew, because near-duplicate passages crowded out the distinctive ones. Architectures that consolidated interactions into durable claims before retrieval held their accuracy across corpus sizes.

Yields fell by a median of 19% during the first three seasons of organic conversion and recovered to within 4% of conventional yields by season six. Farmers without access to transition financing abandoned conversion at more than twice the rate of those who had it, making credit rather than agronomy the dominant barrier to adoption.

Collectives that never aggregated produce still raised member incomes, through shared input procurement, seed exchange and direct buyer introductions. Median realised price rose 11% without any pooled sale of output.

Declared religiosity fell across all surveyed cohorts over the twenty-year window, with the sharpest decline among respondents reporting direct experience of institutional harm. Movement from unaffiliated to actively opposed positions was concentrated in that same group.

Reserved-category admission produced graduation and earnings outcomes indistinguishable from open-category peers by the tenth year after entry. Benefits concentrated within already-advantaged households inside the reserved categories, a capture effect the authors attribute to the absence of an economic criterion.

Stated desire to be remembered correlated with higher lifetime resource consumption, not lower. Respondents scoring highest on legacy motivation reported greater discretionary spending and larger built footprints across every income band.

Systems collapsed not when a component failed but when the components that absorbed variance withdrew. Across the modelled infrastructures, resilience tracked the presence of slack and redundancy far more closely than it tracked average component reliability.

Forgetting is better modelled as active discarding than as passive decay. Participants whose recall of outdated detail declined fastest performed best on generalisation tasks, consistent with limited retention serving compression rather than reflecting a capacity defect.

Politically connected firms earned excess returns concentrated in regulated sectors and around licensing decisions, with no corresponding advantage in productivity. The premium disappeared entirely in sectors where allocation ran through open auction.

Teams that outperformed on shipped outcomes spent proportionally more time on problem definition and less on solution generation. The strongest single predictor was the number of distinct user problems a team could state precisely before proposing any solution.

Practices spread fastest through demonstrated local results rather than through formal instruction. Adoption in the surveyed networks tracked the number of visible nearby adopters far more strongly than exposure to training material.
